title: Definitely needs a lot of work
text: I’ve been using this app now since August. For how much this costs a year which is over $100, the actual experience and tools are quite mediocre and makes the whole subscription feel like a rob. To start, the whole app and its features are very Caucasian central and not friendly to people of color or people who have non-conventional/unique features. An example of this is the ‘Looks tab’, whenever you use a photo of a dark skinned person, the sliders make their skin lighter and gives them conventionally attractive white features, the app should have more diverse options for diverse people. Second, the vanish tool is almost useless. It needs more specific tools depending on what you want to do, for example; add a remove tool for erasing elements in a photo you don’t want, and a addition tool that adds more elements to a nearby area (such as you touch the screen to visually add more hair strands near the hair), because right now the vanish tool is a guessing feature that does the opposite of what you want. The AI prompt system that comes with it is also very low quality and if you want a specific result, it doesn’t listen and it cannot even increase the resolution of images. It actually progressively makes the quality worse from what I’ve seen, fades out details or slightly warps them. Third, the makeup tab such as the eyelashes feature and contour are cheap, and you can see once again, the contour was made with only light skinned people in mind. Instead of fixing these things you have added AI videos which is already mediocre alone and unnecessary for the majority of people who use the app for basic photo editing. There are so many things in the app I feel don’t live up to the price of the expensive subscription. I’m disappointed and will eventually cancel when the date comes, until they fix the app.

title: Cancel - False Advertising & Lesson For All
text:
I ran this as a trial and downloaded from the App Store. Tested it out immediately with my son and found it to be very buggy and not do what we initially thought it would. Because of the expensive rate, I immediately cancelled the subscription in the App Store.

Over a month later I suddenly got a charge. When I went to verify that I had cancelled, I saw the cancellation in the App Store and went to ask for support. When trying to login to the website, there was no active subscription. I asked for a refund and presented the receipt showing the charge. It seems that it was reviewed immediately by an AI app and showed that it logged me in under my email address when signing up, so my App Store (iPhone ID) was not a valid cancellation and that I never cancelled with them directly on their website under my email login, instead of my phone login.

I noticed this and immediately cancelled under my email. I won’t be getting a refund though according to the AI email response I was given. If you also need to cancel the trial YOU MUST be sure that the cancel is done on their website directly…or they will still ding you automatically regardless of if you cancel through the App Store. Definitely reporting this to Apple.
